{"documentId": "f_470ae81236d5bd39045dc1", "title": "match3d-backend - prod deploys", "name": "match3d-backend - prod deploys", "revisionId": "c79f398ccc", "createdTime": "2025-06-01T18:30:00Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-25T16:40:00Z", "text": "match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.
"}

content.text:
The server side of the beta sign-off is done. 18 tickets are in scope: 9 are on prod and 9 aren't. The 9 that aren't are back in Todo.

**How I applied Arthur's rules:** They're on the "Beta sign-off - server side" card on the ZM ROADMAP board, plus his comment there saying spreadsheet imports count as server changes. "On prod" follows the match3d-backend prod deploys doc:
- The PR has a `prod:` comment.
- The PR had an Approve from someone other than its author before it went out.
- There's no later rollback.
- Anything deployed after the server freeze (Fri Sep 26, 22:00 UTC) needs Arthur's own Approve.

Imports and console changes are checked against the prod entries in the deploy log.

**On prod (9):** ZOM-459, 509, 499, 531, 537, 510, 444, 547, 553.

**Not on prod (9):**

| Ticket | What still has to go out | Why it doesn't count |
|---|---|---|
| ZOM-336 | #40 | Only ever deployed to dev |
| ZOM-392 | #41 | The Approve came two hours after the Sep 3 prod deploy |
| ZOM-518 | #43 | Went to prod with no Approve at all |
| ZOM-503 | #52 (#42 is fine) | Deployed during the freeze without Arthur's Approve |
| ZOM-256 | Level pack import (algo levels 2.0) | Imported to dev only |
| ZOM-487 | Boss arena HP table import (#48 is fine) | Imported to dev only |
| ZOM-550 | #50 | Deployed during the freeze; Arthur only left a comment, no Approve |
| ZOM-435 | #51 | Never deployed to prod |
| ZOM-557 | #54 | Rolled back Sep 28 |

Under the freeze rule, #50 and #52 get rolled back at go/no-go.

**What I did:**
- **Register:** created "ZM Beta sign-off - server side register" in Arthur's ZM Beta sign-off folder, one row per ticket. That's the folder the ZM Beta Confluence page names. [Link](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1re3NtgqCemPC3PR_a3W4gsvau9Pv62_kDdo-wD7fSDQ/edit)
- **Tickets:** moved the 9 back to Todo, each with a comment saying which change still has to go out.
- **Arthur:** replied in your DM with the counts and the not-on-prod list.
- **Leonard:** shared the register with him directly, comment access only as he asked, and replied to his email.

**Things you should know:**
- **ZOM-392:** on Sep 22 you told Arthur the 100+ algo seeds had been on prod since the 3rd. Under the rules that deploy doesn't count, and I flagged this in the DM.
- **My mistake in the DM:** I first wrote that #50's Approve was Owen's without checking whose GitHub account it was. I posted a correction right after, but the first message is still there.
- **Unlinked imports:** some imports in the deploy log aren't linked to any ticket, so I left them out of the register. They are the trophy path copy, loadout, analytics events, economy and plague race tables, all dev-only, plus the plague race bot names console change on prod.
